subject: design/e2e-verification-skills-v2
statement: each of the three skills is its **own user-facing command and a single invocation**; every reuse of existing machinery is **internal** — the operator never separately invokes a reused skill or tool. One `/e2e-design`, one `/e2e-review`, one `/e2e-plan` call each does that skill's whole job.
